class.name: VehicleAppearance
class.brief_description: What a kind of vehicle looks like.
class.description: The models it is drawn with: the exterior, the low-poly interior, the passengers and the attachments, their skins and where they sit in the vehicle's frame. Shared by every vehicle of the kind and handed to its kind's renderer ([VehicleRenderingServer]); a kind of vehicle's appearance derives from it with the submodels its renderer turns ([RailVehicleAppearance], [RoadVehicleAppearance]).

members.member: Models drawn with the exterior, in its frame and with its skins.
The low-poly interior seen through the windows.
Where every model of the vehicle sits in the vehicle's own frame.

The [ModelRenderingServer] backend the vehicle's models are loaded and drawn by, by the name it is registered with ([method ModelRenderingServer.backend_register]); empty for the project's default backend. A model a plugin's renderer adds of its own (a cargo, a coupler's adapter) is drawn by the default backend.
The models' replaceable textures - a livery's - by the name of the slot the materials that take them name ([method ModelRenderingServer.instance_set_replaceable_textures]); empty for the models' own.
The skins of the models' replaceable materials, by number.
